expectations.text: Output identifies 5 or more distinct domains affected
expectations.evidence: 5 areas identified: Engineering Team, Infrastructure, Restaurant Partners, Development Speed, Costs/Reliability. Borderline — 'Costs' and 'Reliability' are categories, not stakeholder domains. Missing: End Customers, Hiring Pipeline, Investor Relations, Product Velocity as distinct domain

expectations.text: Output traces at least 2 orders of effects beyond first-order for the majority of domains
expectations.evidence: Only the 'Development Speed' section has multiple orders (short/medium/long term), and those are time horizons not causal chains. Other sections list first-order effects as bullet points without tracing consequences. E.g., 'Engineers need to learn new concepts' stops there without exploring what happens because of the learning gap

expectations.text: Output identifies at least 2 feedback loops with mechanism explanations
expectations.evidence: Zero feedback loops identified. No circular causal dynamics described anywhere in the output

expectations.text: Output labels feedback loops as amplifying or dampening
expectations.evidence: No feedback loops present, so no labeling possible

expectations.text: Output is structured with clear domain-by-domain organization
expectations.evidence: Has separate sections for Engineering Team, Infrastructure, Restaurant Partners, Development Speed, Costs, and Reliability. While not as clean as stakeholder domains, there is domain-level organization

expectations.text: Output includes at least 1 counter-intuitive or non-obvious effect
expectations.evidence: The nuance that 'cross-service features may actually be slower due to coordination overhead' challenges the VP's 3x claim. Also the conclusion that CloudKitchen's size may make microservices counterproductive is a non-obvious position

expectations.text: Output provides mechanisms (why/because) for causal chains, not just listing effects
expectations.evidence: Most effects are stated without mechanisms. E.g., 'API contract changes as monolith endpoints are decomposed' — states what happens but not the consequence chain or why it matters. Brief bullet format prevents mechanism explanation
